synthesis.body: urlopen never lets ssl.SSLCertVerificationError escape directly for a connect-phase failure; it arrives as URLError with the SSL error in .reason. Code matching on the bare exception type silently never fires. Check both shapes. Separately, urlopen only wraps failures raised during connect: a stall or TLS error while a response body is still streaming escapes unwrapped, so a handler that catches only URLError leaks a bare TimeoutError or ssl.SSLError to the caller.
